title: Document names a subdomain of the endpoint's host
rationale: Kept distinct from `unrelated_host` because the paper's rhetorical punch - an unrelated resource naming the same issuer - must not be diluted by same-operator subdomain drift counted in the same bucket.

spec.quote: The `resource` value returned MUST be identical to the protected resource's resource identifier value into which the well-known URI path suffix was inserted to create the URL used to retrieve the metadata. If these values are not identical, the data contained in the response MUST NOT be used.

documents.comment: everything but the `resource` value is conforming
conforming, so only C12 is under test
